{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Republican Governors and State legislatures are ready to do the hard work of modernizing Medicaid for the twenty-first century.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for block-granting Medicaid to the States, providing the States with the flexibility to design programs that meet the needs of their low income citizens.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for achieving reforms through premium supports or a refundable tax credit, allowing non-disabled adults and children to be moved into private health insurance of their choice, where their needs can be met on the same basis as those of more affluent Americans.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"For the aged and disabled under Medicaid, States would have flexibility to improve the quality of care and to avoid the inappropriate institutional placing of patients who prefer to be cared for at home.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
